# shining instead and can start over later.

# The Führer's Tremor
country_event = {
	id = wif_ger_road_auto.1
	hidden = yes
	is_triggered_only = yes

	trigger = {
		NOT = { has_completed_focus = GER_the_fuhrers_tremor }
	}

	immediate = {
		deactivate_shine_on_focus = GER_the_fuhrers_tremor
		clr_country_flag = GER_the_fuhrers_tremor_in_progress_flag
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_country_flag = wif_ger_himmler_is_fuhrer }
				NOT = { has_country_flag = wif_ger_fuhrer_dead }
			}
			complete_national_focus = {
				focus = GER_the_fuhrers_tremor
				use_side_message = yes
			}
		}
		wif_ger_road_try_all = yes
	}
}

# Swiss Gold
country_event = {
	id = wif_ger_road_auto.29
	hidden = yes
	is_triggered_only = yes

	trigger = {
		NOT = { has_completed_focus = GER_swiss_gold }
	}

	immediate = {
		deactivate_shine_on_focus = GER_swiss_gold
		clr_country_flag = GER_swiss_gold_in_progress_flag
		if = {
			limit = {
				wif_ger_speer_in_inner_circle = yes
				OR = {
					AND = { country_exists = SWI NOT = { has_war_with = SWI } }
					AND = { country_exists = SWE NOT = { has_war_with = SWE } }
				}
			}
			complete_national_focus = {
				focus = GER_swiss_gold
				use_side_message = yes
				originator_name = GER_albert_speer
			}
		}
		wif_ger_road_try_all = yes
	}
